  • Decide at the point of intake, rather than mid-delivery, which items should go to the consultant from the start and which the internal HRIS team should own, based on complexity, specialist skill requirements, timeline pressure and internal capacity.

  • Track the split between internal and consultant delivery, and advise leadership on where that boundary should sit as internal capability grows.

  • Workday Pro certification or partner certification in Compensation, Advanced Compensation or Integrations.

  • Provide hands-on guidance to engineering teams on implementation patterns, reusable components, deployment standards and technical issue resolution.

  • Guide observability design across application traces, agent traces, prompt and tool execution, model performance, API metrics, data pipeline health, cost usage and business process outcomes.
  • Support capacity planning and cloud cost optimization, including workload sizing, token consumption controls, autoscaling, caching, batching and appropriate service selection.
  • Collaborate with the Lead Manager and Solution Lead to balance delivery timelines with architecture quality and enterprise readiness.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise solution architecture, cloud architecture, platform engineering or related technology leadership roles.
  • Strong hands-on architecture experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise deployment patterns.
  • Proven experience designing distributed systems, APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, containerized workloads and cloud-native integrations.
  • Strong understanding of GenAI and agentic AI architecture, including LLM orchestration, tool calling, RAG, state and memory patterns, evaluation, guardrails and human approval mechanisms.
  • Ability to design architectures that combine conventional software services, AI/ML models, optimization engines, data pipelines and agentic workflows.
  • Strong knowledge of security, identity, networking, observability, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and production operations in enterprise environments.
  • Experience engaging with client architects, CIO/CTO organizations, cloud platform teams, security stakeholders and delivery teams.
  • Strong ability to communicate architecture trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders and drive decisions under real-world constraints.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, AKS, Container Apps, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Key Vault, Entra ID and Azure Monitor.
  • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or equivalent patterns and frameworks.
  • Exposure to supply chain, demand forecasting, planning, semiconductor or high-tech industry solutions.
  • Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, model monitoring, prompt and agent evaluation and production AI governance.
  • Relevant Azure architecture certifications or equivalent demonstrable experience.

Key Deliverables

  • Target-state solution architecture and Azure service deployment blueprint.
  • Agent architecture and orchestration design, including tool boundaries and control flows.
  • End-to-end sequence flows for key business scenarios and exception paths.
  • Integration, API, identity, networking, security, observability and environment architecture.
  • Architecture decision records, non-functional requirements, deployment standards and engineering guardrails.
  • Production-readiness and scalability recommendations, including cost and operational considerations.

Key Success Metrics

  • Architecture is accepted by client technology and security stakeholders with minimal late-stage redesign.
  • Solution is deployable, scalable, secure, observable and supportable across enterprise environments.
  • Agent and orchestration patterns remain controlled, explainable and appropriate to the business workflow.
  • Reduction in integration rework, deployment friction, technical debt and avoidable cloud cost.
  • Engineering teams can implement consistently using clear architecture standards and reusable patterns.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary
Nexla is the leading Integration platform, built with AI, for AI. Nexla takes a metadata driven approach to converge diverse integrations across Data, Documents, Agents, Applications, and APIs into a single design pattern. We accelerate the development of solutions for GenAI, Analytics, and Inter-company data. Nexla makes data users and developers up to 10x more productive by delivering a true blend of no-code, low-code, and pro-code interfaces.
Leading companies including DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, and LiveRamp trust Nexla for mission-critical data. Named in the 2022, 2023, and 2024 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights, headquartered in San Mateo, California.
At Nexla, our culture is built around our core values: Have Empathy , Be Curious , Be Intellectually Honest , Achieve Excellence , and Remember to Relax . We put our customers at the heart of everything we do, foster a data-driven mindset, take ownership of our work, and believe in the power of teamwork to achieve ambitious goals.
Nexla, briefly
Nexla is the data layer for enterprise AI. We give AI apps and agents the connectivity, context, and governance to work across more than 1,000 enterprise systems in real time, and we process over a trillion records a month doing it. DoorDash, LinkedIn, Johnson & Johnson, Instacart, and LiveRamp run mission-critical data on us. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running. Founded 2016, remote-first, headquartered in San Mateo.
Our values are short and we actually use them: Have Empathy. Be Curious. Be Intellectually Honest. Achieve Excellence. Remember to Relax.
Role, briefly
Nexla s connector layer is what talks to everything else: over a thousand SaaS applications, databases, streams, files, and APIs, bidirectionally, each with its own schema quirks, auth scheme, rate limits, and retry semantics. You would be the most senior engineer on it, and the person four to six engineers report to, working alongside our backend, API, and UI teams. The split is roughly 80% hands-on design and code, 20% growing the team. If you are looking to step off the keyboard, this is the wrong job.
What you ll own
  • The architecture of the connector layer. You make the calls on how we abstract a thousand systems and handle formats like JSON, Parquet, and Avro at high throughput, and you write the hard parts yourself.
  • The connector roadmap. You decide what ships, what gets deprecated, and in what order, working directly with product, customer success, and support on what customers actually need.
  • Reliability of what your team ships, on-call included. Fewer failures reaching customers, and better tooling so the team sees problems before customers do.
  • The four to six engineers around you. Hiring, growth, and raising the technical bar, mostly through design review and pairing. Formal management runs to about a day a week.
Ninety days in: you have shipped something non-trivial to production, named the two worst parts of the current design with a proposal attached, and the team has started routing hard design questions to you before they route them upward.
A real problem you d hit here
We have thousands of connectors, with thousands of customer pipelines running on them. Each one has to scale in two directions at once: the volume of data moving through it, and its reliability under that volume. This is not a problem you solve and close. The connector surface keeps growing, so holding both properties is a constantly evolving task, and it is the standing problem of this team.
Must-haves
  • 10+ years building backend systems, and you are still hands-on. You can point at code you wrote recently and are proud of.
  • Deep JVM experience. You have debugged distributed systems where the failure was not in the code you wrote.
  • Production depth in Kafka, Redis or Memcached, and APIs over gRPC and REST, Kubernetes at high throughput.
  • You have led engineers technically: design review, mentoring, raising the bar on a team. Formal people-management experience is welcome but not required.
  • You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.
Bonus points
  • Data integration, ETL, or iPaaS background.
  • You have wrangled JSON, Parquet, Avro, and worse at scale.
  • You have carried direct reports before, including performance conversations.
You ll thrive here if
  • Urgency is your default. Youd rather ship a good answer this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you make that call without being asked.
  • You own the outcome, not your slice of it. When something breaks between two teams, you fix it rather than route it.
  • You close loops. What you pick up gets finished, and the people around you stop having to follow up.
  • You set the pace. Four to six engineers will calibrate their urgency to yours, and you know that.
  • You want the design authority that comes with the title without giving up the keyboard.
One thing to be clear about: this role grows through technical depth and scope, not through headcount. The 80/20 split is deliberate and will stay that way
How we hire
  • Exploratory call with our CTO. A real conversation about the problem space and whether this scope is what you actually want. 45 min.
  • Design and architecture. How you shape systems, on problems close to what we run in production. 60 min.
  • Distributed systems design. Throughput, failure modes, and the tradeoffs you would defend under pressure. 60 min.
  • Coding. Working through real code rather than a puzzle. 60 min.
  • Leadership conversation with a co-founder. Ownership, judgment, and how you raise the bar of the people around you. 45 min.
On AI in the coding round.
Use it the way you would on the job, ours or anyone else s. We build AI tooling and we expect you to use AI tooling, so watching you work without it would tell us nothing useful. What we dig into is your judgment: what you delegated, what you verified, and what you threw away.
You will hear from us either way.
The practical stuff
Worth a look before you apply:
  • What we are building now. MCP Studio and Express , our two newest bets.
  • Who uses us, and why.
  • The product in engineer terms.
  • Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax"

jobDescription:
Aziro is looking for a Senior Product Manager with strong product judgment, meaningful AI fluency, and experience building products in financial services or a closely related domain.

You will own a product area end-to-end, from market and customer discovery through roadmap planning, delivery, launch, and performance measurement. You will work closely with engineering, design, customer success, go-to-market teams, and client stakeholders to ensure that products solve real customer problems and deliver measurable business value.

This role is designed for a product manager who uses AI as a core part of their daily workflow to accelerate research, improve decisions, create prototypes, and raise the quality of product execution.

This is a remote, India-based position supporting a US-based product organization. The role reports to Aziros product or delivery leadership and works closely with the client’s Director of Product Management.


Key Responsibilities

Product Management

  • Develop a deep understanding of the market, competitors, users, buyers, and emerging trends through customer interviews, data analysis, and structured feedback loops.
  • Own and evolve a 6-12 month product roadmap, including priorities, dependencies, delivery progress, and changing customer or business needs.
  • Translate customer needs, stakeholder input, and market insights into clear product initiatives, epics, requirements, and user stories.
  • Define and track product KPIs related to customer adoption, retention, engagement, revenue, and overall product health.
  • Measure whether released features deliver the intended customer and business value, and use those findings to guide future product decisions.
  • Lead products and major features from discovery and validation through launch, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Bring clear analysis, recommendations, and a defensible point of view to roadmap, planning, and stakeholder discussions.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior leadership to align product vision, positioning, priorities, and execution.
  • Identify opportunities for product differentiation and run focused experiments to validate new ideas quickly.
  • Guide Product Owners, Business Analysts, and junior Product Managers on prioritization, backlog management, user-story quality, and product execution.
  • Step into Product Owner responsibilities when needed to maintain delivery momentum.

AI-Native Product Execution

  • Use AI tools as core components of the product management workflow rather than as occasional productivity tools.
  • Use AI to accelerate:Customer and market research
  • Competitive analysis
  • Interview and feedback synthesis
  • Data analysis
  • Product requirements and specifications
  • User stories and acceptance criteria
  • Executive and stakeholder communication
  • Build or guide the creation of working prototypes using tools such as Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Lovable, Replit, or similar platforms.
  • Use prototypes to test product direction with customers and stakeholders before committing significant engineering resources.
  • Apply strong product judgment to validate AI-generated outputs, identify limitations, and determine where human analysis and decision-making remain essential.
  • Share effective AI workflows and practices with the broader product and delivery teams.

Financial Services Domain

  • Develop a strong understanding of the client’s financial products, customer journeys, operating environment, and business model.
  • Translate financial-services customer needs into product priorities with measurable business outcomes.
  • Understand how product decisions may affect areas such as:Customer onboarding
  • Payments and transactions
  • Account servicing
  • Risk and compliance
  • Data security and privacy
  • Revenue and pricing
  • Customer retention
  • Operational efficiency

  • Identify churn risks, deal blockers, customer pain points, and expansion opportunities and convert them into actionable product priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software, SaaS, product engineering, or technology services, including at least 4 years in product management.
  • Proven experience owning a product or major product area from discovery through launch and ongoing performance measurement.
  • Experience building and managing a 6–12 month product roadmap.
  • Demonstrated success delivering measurable customer and business outcomes, including adoption, retention, revenue, efficiency, or customer satisfaction.
  • Meaningful experience using AI tools in product management. Candidates should be able to explain:How AI has changed their workflow
  • Which activities it has accelerated or replaced
  • Examples of prototypes or analyses they have created
  • Where AI tools have produced weak or unreliable results
  • Where human product judgment remains essential
  • Experience with AI-assisted prototyping or development tools such as Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Lovable, Replit, or similar platforms.
  • Experience in financial services, fintech, banking, payments, insurance, lending, wealth management, financial software, or a related industry.
  • Candidates without direct financial-services experience must demonstrate strong subject-matter expertise or substantial experience building products for regulated or transaction-intensive industries.
  • Strong understanding of customer discovery, market analysis, product positioning, packaging, pricing, and go-to-market strategy.
  • Strong business and revenue fluency, including the ability to connect product priorities to:Customer adoption
  • Churn risk
  • Deal blockers
  • Retention
  • Expansion opportunities
  • Revenue growth
  • Experience mentoring or guiding Product Owners, Business Analysts, junior Product Managers, or similar team members.
  • Strong experience working in Agile environments, including backlog management, delivery planning, and process improvement.
  • Ability to present product recommendations, trade-offs, and decisions to executives, clients, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong working understanding of APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure, networks, software architecture, and data flows.
  • Strong experience with Jira and product documentation practices.
  • Experience working with US-based stakeholders and distributed engineering teams is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a technology services or client-facing consulting environment is preferred.

Ideal Candidate Attributes

Strong Product Manager

Demonstrates clear product judgment, understands customers and markets, makes effective prioritization decisions, and connects roadmap choices to measurable outcomes.

AI-Native

Uses AI daily for research, synthesis, analysis, prototyping, documentation, and communication. Can demonstrate how AI has materially improved the speed and quality of their work.

Financial Services-Oriented

Understands financial-services products, customer journeys, commercial models, risk considerations, and the importance of accuracy, trust, security, and compliance.

Customer-Focused

Engages directly with users and buyers, identifies meaningful problems, and prioritizes work based on customer value rather than stakeholder volume.

Strategic and Hands-On

Can define product direction while also working through discovery, requirements, backlog refinement, prototyping, launch, and performance analysis.

Outcome-Oriented

Connects product decisions to adoption, retention, revenue, operational improvement, and customer success. Treats launch as the beginning of accountability.

Influential Leader

Builds trust across teams, communicates clearly with senior stakeholders, and drives progress across functions, organizations, and time zones.

Clarity Benefit Solutions is seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics & Enterprise Solutions Architect to lead the implementation, administration, and ongoing evolution of our Microsoft business platform.

The successful candidate will serve as the technical leader responsible for a unified Microsoft-based business platform that connects customer relationship management, service operations, workflow automation, enterprise data, analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, and system integrations into a single operating environment.


This platform will serve as the foundation for how Clarity manages Sales, Client Services, Operations, Implementation, Renewals, Finance, Compliance, and future AI-enabled capabilities. Change Leadership & Business Transformation

  • Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping teams redesign and modernize business processes rather than simply replicate existing workflows.
  • Lead organizational adoption of Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Copilot, AI-enabled solutions, and modern Microsoft technologies.
  • Challenge legacy processes and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational efficiency.
  • Facilitate workshops to evaluate current-state processes and design future-state solutions.
  • Drive business transformation initiatives by aligning technology investments with organizational objectives.
  • Champion a culture of automation, data-driven decision making, continuous improvement, and innovation.
  • Develop adoption strategies, training plans, communication programs, and success metrics.
  • Influence stakeholders at all levels and build consensus around technology and process improvements

Enterprise Architecture & Platform Leadership

  • Own the overall architecture and technology roadmap for Clarity's Microsoft business platform.
  • Create scalable architecture patterns across business applications, data platforms, integrations, automation, reporting, and AI.
  • Align Dynamics 365, Dataverse, Power Platform, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Services, Power BI, Copilot, and third-party platforms into a cohesive enterprise architecture.
  • Define architecture standards, solution governance, security frameworks, and technical best practices.
  • Lead architecture reviews and ensure consistency across all platform investments.
  • Evaluate new technologies and ensure platform decisions support Clarity's long-term strategic objectives

Microsoft Dynamics 365 Platform Leadership

  • Serve as the subject matter expert and platform owner for Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service.
  • Lead the migration from Salesforce to Dynamics 365.
  • Design and maintain custom entities, tables, forms, views, dashboards, business rules, workflows, and security models.
  • Configure and optimize lead management, opportunity management, account management, client onboarding, renewals, service delivery, and customer support processes.
  • Establish governance standards, documentation standards, and platform administration practices.
  • Guide solution design decisions and ensure scalability of the Dynamics environment

Workflow Automation & Process Optimization

  • Design and build enterprise workflows using Dynamics 365, Power Automate, Power Apps, Business Process Flows, custom approvals, and AI-enabled automation.
  • Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work and improve productivity.
  • Design intelligent routing, escalation management, exception handling, and automated task management processes.
  • Partner with business leaders to simplify and improve operational workflows

Data Architecture & Enterprise Analytics

  • Design and maintain enterprise data architecture using Dataverse, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure technologies, and related platforms.
  • Define data governance, data quality, security, retention, and compliance standards.
  • Develop scalable data models that support reporting, analytics, automation, and AI initiatives.
  • Design and maintain master data strategies and integration frameworks.
  • Support real-time and operational reporting requirements across departments.
  • Ensure enterprise data infrastructure supports future growth and innovation.

Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation

  • Lead the design and implementation of AI-enabled business solutions.
  • Drive adoption of Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI Agents, and intelligent automation capabilities.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-value AI use cases.
  • Design predictive analytics, intelligent routing, workflow automation, and decision-support solutions.
  • Establish governance and standards for AI-enabled business applications.

Integration & API Strategy

  • Lead enterprise integration initiatives between Dynamics, internal systems, external partners, and third-party platforms.
  • Design and support API strategies that enable secure and scalable information exchange.
  • Leverage Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, and related technologies where appropriate.
  • Ensure system integrations adhere to security, compliance, scalability, and supportability standards.

Reporting & Business Intelligence

  • Develop dashboards, analytics solutions, and executive reporting using Dynamics 365, Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and related tools.
  • Create reporting frameworks that provide insight into customer engagement, operational performance, growth opportunities, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Partner with business leaders to define KPIs and measurement strategies.
  • Enable self-service reporting and analytics where appropriate.

Collaboration & Business Partnership

  • Work closely with Sales, Client Services, Operations, Compliance, Finance, and IT teams.
  • Translate business needs into scalable technology solutions.
  • Lead solution workshops, architecture reviews, and project meetings.
  • Build strong relationships across departments and serve as a trusted technology advisor.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 10+ years of technology and enterprise application experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 experience.
  • 3+ years implementing Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service.
  • Deep expertise with Dataverse, Power Automate, Power Apps, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and Power BI.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure services, APIs, and enterprise integrations.
  • Strong knowledge of CRM architecture, enterprise architecture, business process design, and data modeling.
  • Experience leading platform modernization or enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Experience leading technical teams and architecture governance.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications.
  • Experience migrating from Salesforce to Dynamics 365.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, Azure Integration Services, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience with Copilot Studio, AI Agents, and intelligent workflow automation.
  • Experience in benefits administration, healthcare, financial services, insurance, or other highly regulated industries.
  • Experience managing offshore and distributed development teams.

title: Sr Manager, Inception - South Asia Region
jobDescription:
NVIDIA Inception is our free global programme for start-ups building with AI, data science and accelerated computing - now more than 40, 000 companies worldwide, with over 2, 000 of them based in India alone. South Asia is one of the fastest-moving corners of that network: a market whose density sits in applied and vertical AI - medical imaging, drug discovery, edge vision, agentic and sovereign AI, robotics, agri-tech, AI governance - rather than in frontier model labs.

We are looking for an Inception Regional Lead to own that motion end to end. This is a builder s role with a commercial edge. You will set the regional strategy, lead a team of Inception Partner and Community managers across India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and neighbouring markets, and be personally accountable for how much NVIDIA hardware, software and cloud the region s start-ups design in and consume. You will spend real time on the ground in founders offices, because that is where stalled accounts turn into concrete asks. And you will act as the connective tissue between start-ups and the rest of NVIDIA - worldwide field operations, solution architects, developer marketing, the reseller and cloud partner ecosystem, and NVentures.

What you ll be doing:

  • Own the South Asia Inception strategy and number. Set regional priorities, coverage model and account tiering across strategic, member, community and prospect accounts; forecast and report on pipeline, design wins and consumption to programme and field leadership.

  • Lead and grow the team. Manage, coach and develop a team of Inception Partner and community programme managers. Set territory and vertical coverage, run the operating cadence, and raise the bar on technical fluency and commercial rigour across the team.

  • Drive commercial outcomes with start-ups. Move accounts from awareness to technical discovery to a named workload - running workload, benchmark and target-metric discovery, qualifying architecture and annual cloud spend, and landing hardware and cloud asks through the Inception Benefits Catalog, rebate programmes, DGX Cloud credits and preferred pricing.

  • Build the partner and reseller motion. Work with OEMs, resellers, cloud and NVIDIA Cloud Partners and system integrators so that start-up demand converts cleanly into fulfilled orders and deployed capacity.

  • Deepen the ecosystem. Build durable relationships with the region s VCs and accelerators through the Inception VC Alliance, and with research parks, IITs and university incubators, government innovation bodies and industry associations, to generate high-quality inbound and give members a route to capital and customers.

  • Land the technical value. Partner with solution architects and developer relations to get members productive on the NVIDIA stack - NIM, NeMo, Nemotron, Riva, Isaac Sim, Omniverse, Morpheus, Clara, Jetson, DGX and AI Enterprise - and drive Deep Learning Institute training, hackathons, workshops and bring-your-own-project days at scale.

  • Tell the region s story. Work with developer and Inception marketing on co-marketing plans, technical blogs, member showcases, testimonials and video, and represent Inception at GTC, AI Summits, and regional start-up and investor events.

  • Run the programme cleanly. Own member onboarding, tier qualification, data hygiene and reporting in NVIDIA s programme and CRM systems, so that regional performance is measurable and auditable.

  • Bring the market back to NVIDIA. Feed structured intelligence on regional workloads, competitive pressure, sovereign AI initiatives and funding trends to product, field and executive stakeholders.

What we need to see:

  • 12+ years of experience across start-up ecosystem development, developer or partner programmes, technology alliances, business development or technical sales - with at least 5 years leading and developing a team.

  • BS/BTech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. MBA or advanced degree welcome.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a commercial target in a technology business, with a track record of turning early-stage relationships into revenue, design wins or measurable platform adoption.

  • Working technical fluency in AI and accelerated computing: you can hold a credible conversation with a founder or CTO about model training and inference, GPU selection and sizing, on-premises versus cloud trade-offs, and where NVIDIA s software stack fits.

  • Deep, current knowledge of the South Asian start-up ecosystem - founders, investors, accelerators, incubators, research institutions and the policy environment - and the network to open doors quickly.

  • Proven success operating in a large, matrixed organization, influencing sales, marketing, engineering and executive stakeholders without formal authority.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to founders, investors and NVIDIA executives with equal ease.

  • Willingness to travel frequently across the region.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Direct experience at a start-up, VC firm, accelerator or incubator - you know how founders actually make decisions and where programmes create or destroy value for them.

  • Hands-on background with GPU infrastructure, cluster deployment or MLOps, or prior experience as a solution architect or developer advocate.

  • Experience building go-to-market motions with cloud providers, OEMs, resellers or system integrators in India.

  • A public track record in the AI community - speaking, writing, or convening founders and investors.

  • Experience with sovereign AI, regulated-industry AI (healthcare, financial services, public sector) or edge and robotics deployments in emerging markets.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and DevSecOps practices.
  • Working knowledge of OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 and fine-grained authorization in multi-tenant SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, including API-led connectivity, event-driven messaging, asynchronous communication patterns, data synchronization, system interoperability, and integration platform technologies used to connect cloud, SaaS, and custom applications.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; experience presenting designs to senior technology stakeholders.
  • Professional services or B2B SaaS product experience is advantageous.
  • Experience with BPM and integration platforms (e.g., Camunda, Boomi, MuleSoft) is highly desirable.

  • API Design
  • Azure Service Bus
  • React

  • Python

  • Azure Cloud

Job Type: Full-Time

Position Summary
The Global HEOR Evidence Synthesis Manager plays a critical role in supporting Amgens global market access and health economics strategy through contributing statistical capabilities and methodological leadership for evidence synthesis methodologies (meta-analyses ITCs). This role will partner closely with Global HEOR Product Leads to ensure strong alignment with product strategy. The Evidence Synthesis Senior Manager will lead different evidence pooling analyses ranging from meta-analyses, network meta-analyses to population-adjusted indirect treatment comparisons (MAICs and STCs) and health-economic analyses facilitating HTA and payer decision-making.
Educational Qualifications
ABachelors, Master''s or Doctoral-level degree in applied statistics, biostatistics, mathematics, operations research, engineering, health economics, pharmacy, and related quantitative fields

  • Years of relevant experience in evidence synthesis and statistical analyses in the pharmaceutical, biotech or consulting setting: +12 years for Masters degree and +14 years for Bachelors degree.
  • Expertise in research design and statistical methods, including estimating survival, pooled treatment effects and other methods to estimate treatment effect
  • Experience in leading health economic analyses such as cost-effectiveness/cost-utility (e.g., markov, partitioned survival model), cost minimization, budget impact, and other techniques, as appropriate
  • Proficiency with modeling and statistical tools such as Excel, WinBugs, OpenBugs, JAGS, R or Python.
  • Experience in AI/ ML techniques and Bayesian statistics is a plus.

  • Design and provide methodological leadership in advanced evidence synthesis and statistical analyses such as Pairwise Meta-Analysis, Surrogate outcome assessment, Survival analysis, External Control Arm (ECA) analysis, Indirect treatment comparison (ITCs), Network Meta-Analysis, Match adjusted indirect treatment analysis(MAIC), Simulated treatment comparison (STC) and Meta-regression
  • Design and lead health economic models for products at all stages of development and launch, using cost-effectiveness/cost-utility (e.g., markov, partitioned survival model), cost minimization, budget impact, and other techniques, as appropriate.
  • Ensure quality standards are adhered to in all analyses and new methodologies and techniques are adequately assessed and implemented.
  • Plan and conduct statistical analyses of clinical trials, RWE and other relevant data sources and develop supporting technical documentation for statistical analyses and economic models.

  • Innovative use of artificial intelligence to boost efficiency.
Organizational Behaviors
  • Effective cross-functional collaboration and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, independent, and detail-oriented approach to problem-solving.
  • Comfortable working in a global team across time zones and cultures.

jobDescription:
Principal Scientist AI/ML Workflow & Ecosystem Lead (Large Molecule Discovery Informatics)


What you will do

In this vital and exciting role, you will serve as a Principal Scientist within the Research organization, leading the integration and scaling of artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) capabilities across the Large Molecule Discovery (LMD) informatics ecosystem. You will be responsible for translating advanced computational models into robust, production-ready solutions that are embedded within scientific workflows and drive measurable impact across biologics research.

As a scientifically grounded leader, you will work closely with experimental and computational scientists to understand research needs and translate them into clear data, workflow, and platform requirements, partnering with technology teams to deliver scalable, production-grade solutions. You will operate at the intersection of science, data, and technology, ensuring that AI/ML capabilities are effectively deployed, adopted, and sustained within a complex R&D environment.

This role plays a key role in advancing AI/ML implementation within Large Molecule Discovery (LMD), working collaboratively with enterprise partners to align with and contribute to broader AI/ML strategies.

This role leads a horizontally integrated AI enablement team accountable for delivering the foundational capabilities required to scale AI within Large Molecule Discovery.

In this role, your core responsibilities include:

  • Lead the transition of AI/ML models from research into production-ready solutions within LMD, ensuring successful integration into domain-specific scientific workflows and informatics systems
  • Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team responsible for AI enablement, data standards, and workflow integration within the LMD ecosystem
  • Drive adoption of AI/ML capabilities within LMD by defining and implementing research-to-production handoff patterns to implement machine learning models into end-to-end discovery workflows and enabling intuitive, reliable user experiences for scientists
  • Provide clear priorities, coaching, and execution oversight to ensure delivery of high-quality, scalable capabilities across a diverse technical team
  • Establish best practices for model reproducibility, documentation, governance, and compliance, aligned with enterprise standards and deployment frameworks
  • Partner directly with experimental and computational scientists to identify high-impact opportunities for AI/ML integration and ensure solutions align with real-world scientific workflows
  • Translate scientific research needs into clear technical, data, and workflow requirements, partnering with technology teams to deliver scalable, production-grade solutions
  • Partner across scientific, data, and technology functions to ensure availability of high-quality, ML-ready datasets and robust data pipelines supporting LMD workflows
  • Enable standardization of complex biological data (e.g., sequencing and assay data) to support reproducible model training and downstream use in LMD
  • Define and advance ontology and metadata frameworks to ensure interoperability and long-term reuse of data across LMD systems and modalities
  • Monitor adoption, performance, and impact of deployed AI/ML capabilities within LMD, including development of metrics, dashboards, and reporting
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives within LMD and coordinate across stakeholders to ensure alignment, manage scientific dependencies, and deliver integrated solutions at scale
  • Collaborate with enterprise AI/ML strategy and platform teams to ensure alignment while representing LMD-specific needs and priorities

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The dynamic professional we seek is a subject matter expert with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree PhD OR PharmD OR MD [and relevant post-doc where applicable] and 5 years of directly related experience

Or

Masters degree and 8 years of directly related experience

Or

Bachelors degree and 10 years of directly related experience

Preferred Qualifications:
  • PhD with 5+ years of experience applying AI/ML in biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or related R&D environments
  • Familiarity with large molecule or biologics discovery workflows
  • Demonstrated experience translating computational models into production systems used in scientific or technical workflows
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary teams across data, software, and scientific domains
  • Strong understanding of machine learning lifecycle management, data engineering, and scalable system integration
  • Experience with scientific data platforms, data modeling, and development of ML-ready datasets
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives in matrixed organizations
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to influence and align stakeholders across scientific and technical domains
  • Experience defining and measuring adoption and impact of digital or AI-driven capabilities

AI Powered Tech Talent. Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration

Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.

Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.

jobDescription:
Transformation Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. You will lead the end-to-end transformation execution, ensuring programs deliver committed business outcomes, financial targets, operational improvements, and stakeholder expectations across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Transformation Delivery
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Years of Exp: 12 - 17 years

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions.

Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.
  • Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.
  • Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.
  • Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.
  • Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
  • Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
  • Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.
  • Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.
  • Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.

What We''re Looking For

  • 12 17 years total experience; 4 6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M $30M range.
  • Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

  • Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.
  • Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.
  • Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.
  • Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management.

Set yourself apart:

  • Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
  • Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
  • Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
  • Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
  • Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient


What s in it for you

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
  • Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everything from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

With 569,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com

Job Summary

The Senior Manager, Finance Risk Management & Controls (FRMC) will support Finance teams through the transition from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA as part of a multi-year Finance transformation programme. As Finance teams perform new ways of working and execute controls during the transition, the role will work collaboratively with stakeholders to provide practical risk and controls advice, support effective control operation, and deliver risk-based assurance testing across Finance processes and controls.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct line-management responsibilities.

Responsibilities

  • Controls Business Partnering
    • Act as a collaborative risk and controls adviser to Finance teams, Global Process Owners, programme teams and control owners involved in the SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA transition.
    • Provide practical, proportionate and commercially focused advice that supports Finance teams while maintaining appropriate independence.
    • Help Finance teams and control owners understand control responsibilities, evidence requirements and risk-based decision points during transition.
    • Advise on control deficiencies and remediation options.
    • Use assurance findings and AQI-generated insights to help stakeholders prioritise actions and strengthen control operation.
    • Collaborate with Internal Audit, External Audit, Compliance, Technology Risk and other assurance functions.
  • Risk and Controls Assurance
    • Assess the design and operating effectiveness of key controls, including SOX controls, as Finance teams execute controls.
    • Use AI agents, analytics and automation to support testing, risk identification and prioritisation.
    • Identify control deficiencies, emerging risks and recurring themes, and produce clear, evidence-based reports.
    • Engage constructively with control owners on control adequacy, evidence quality and remediation plans.
    • Track agreed actions and escalate material risks, delays or unresolved issues.
    • Support thematic and cross-functional reviews across markets and business units.
  • Targeted Controls Design Support
    • Support control design or enhancement where required following assurance findings, remediation activity or significant process change arising from the SAP S/4HANA launch.

Experience and Qualifications

Essential

  • Qualified accountant or risk and assurance professional, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CMA, CPA, CIA or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and control implications of large-scale ERP change in a complex global organisation.
  • 10-15 years experience in finance risk management, internal controls, internal audit, external audit, SOX or finance transformation.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and financial reporting risks.
  • Experience independently delivering assurance reviews and assessing control effectiveness.
  • Strong knowledge of SOX and financial reporting controls.
  • Experience advising, supporting and constructively challenging senior Finance stakeholders and control owners.
  • Strong analytical, judgement, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred

  • CIA, CISA, CRMA or equivalent qualification.
  • Experience using AI agents or comparable AI-enabled assurance tools.

Skills

  • Business Forecasting
  • Data Visualization
  • Data Storytelling
  • Digital Fluency
  • Financial Modeling
  • Financial Performance Improvement
  • Insight Generation
  • Influencing Without Authority
  • Problem Solving

Engineers in India work closely with global peers in the US, the UK, Israel, the UAE, and Mexico. Multi-Account AWS Operations

Which is why we ve built the worlds first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces-and human experiences-at massive scale.

We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. jobDescription:
Title: Principal Outcome Manager
Level: Principal / Senior Director equivalent
Experience: 10-15 years
Location: Hyderabad, India (hybrid; some travel to US client sites)
Reports to: VP / Head of Delivery

About the Role
The Principal Outcome Manager owns business outcomes for our clients - not just projects. This is a senior consulting role that combines deep technology fluency, strong business judgment and disciplined delivery leadership.
It is not a traditional project manager role. The Outcome Manager agrees with the client up-front on what success looks like in measurable terms, leads the team that delivers it, tracks the outcome continuously, and stands behind the realized result.
In one line: agree the outcome, deliver the outcome, and make sure both the client and Tezo win.

Key Responsibilities
1. Discovery and outcome definition
  • Run discovery workshops with client business and technology leaders to uncover the real problem.
  • Translate the clients ambition into 2-4 measurable KPIs with clear baselines and targets.
  • Document and sign off the outcome, the measurement method and the review cadence with the client.
2. Shaping the engagement
  • Partner with sales and pricing to structure a fair, outcome-linked commercial that protects margin and gives the client real upside.
  • Identify risks early and decide - with leadership - whether to pursue, reshape or decline the deal.
  • Co-own the Statement of Work, ensuring every outcome term is unambiguous and measurable.
3. Execution and delivery
  • Build the right cross-functional pod (architects, engineering leads, data scientists, analysts) and set the operating cadence.
  • Drive day-to-day delivery through the leads. You do not write code, but you always know whether the work is on track to the outcome - and intervene early when it is not.
  • Manage scope, risks, dependencies and change with discipline.
4. Outcome tracking and realization
  • Stand up a simple outcome dashboard for each engagement: live KPI values against baseline and target, with leading indicators.
  • Run a weekly internal review and a regular client-facing outcome review. Convert lagging KPIs into corrective actions with owners and dates.
  • Close each engagement with a short outcome memo: what was committed, what was delivered, what the business impact was, what to repeat next time.
5. Stakeholder consulting and communication
  • Act as a trusted advisor to client business and technology sponsors - bring point of view, not just status updates.
  • Translate fluently between the CIO/CTO conversation (architecture, data, AI, technical risk) and the CXO conversation (revenue, cost, customer experience, time-to-market).
  • Manage escalations and disagreements directly; protect the relationship and the outcome at the same time.
  • Identify the next outcome and help grow the account.
6. People and team leadership
  • Lead the engagement pod with clarity on outcome and decision rights.
  • Coach engineering and consulting leads to think in outcomes rather than tasks.
  • Mentor junior consultants and outcome managers; help build the bench.
Experience :
  • 10-15 years total experience, with at least the last 5 years in a senior consulting, engagement leadership or delivery leadership role.
  • Proven track record of personally owning business outcomes - not just managing projects.
  • Strong hands-on engineering background (see Technical Background below). You should be able to ask the right second-order technical questions, even if you no longer build day-to-day.
  • Experience with US enterprise clients from an offshore-anchored base; comfort across India and US time zones.
  • Experience leading multi-disciplinary teams of 15-40 people across geographies.
  • Exposure to non-T&M commercial constructs (outcome-based, milestone-linked, gain-share, managed-service) is a strong plus.
Technical Background
This role requires a real engineering foundation. The Outcome Manager must be credible with client CTOs, enterprise architects and engineering leads, and must be able to challenge technical choices that put the business outcome at risk.
Programming and engineering (must have at least one)
  • Strong hands-on background in .NET (C#) (Microsoft Stack), React/Angular- at least 5 years building production systems, ideally as a lead developer or technical lead earlier in career.
  • Comfortable reviewing code, design documents and architecture artefacts critically.
  • Application, platform and product engineering
  • Experience across one or more of: enterprise application development, platform engineering (internal developer platforms, shared services), product engineering (SaaS / multi-tenant products).
  • Familiarity with modern engineering practices: API-first design, microservices, event-driven architectures, CI/CD, test automation, observability, DevSecOps.
Cloud (must have at least one)
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform - including compute, storage, networking, identity, managed databases and the platforms primary AI/data services.
  • Solid Understanding of cloud-native development - containers (Docker / Kubernetes), serverless, managed services, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform / CloudFormation / Bicep), 12-factor app principles.
  • Awareness of cloud cost, security and resilience trade-offs at enterprise scale.
Architecture
  • Hands-on solution architecture experience - able to shape the end-to-end design of a non-trivial system covering data, services, integration and front-end.
  • Working understanding of enterprise architecture - domain decomposition, integration patterns, reference architectures, ESB / API gateway, identity, master data, security and compliance.
  • Familiarity with one or more architecture frameworks (TOGAF, C4, Well-Architected Frameworks for AWS / Azure / GCP) is a plus.
Data and AI (good to have)
  • Working understanding of modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Synapse, BigQuery), data engineering pipelines, and analytics use cases.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML solution patterns - classical ML, GenAI, RAG, agents, MLOps - at a level credible to client data and AI leadership.
Behavioral Skills and Competencies
  • Business and consulting judgment - strong commercial instincts, hypothesis-driven thinking, comfort with trade-offs.
  • Stakeholder management - executive presence; credible with CXO audiences in writing, on a call and in a room.
  • Communication - clear writing, active listening, ability to translate between technical and business audiences.
  • Delivery discipline - uses KPIs and leading indicators, not status colors and percent-complete.
  • People leadership - coach teams, gives feedback directly and kindly, holds the line on quality.
Education
  • Bachelor s degree in engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline (required).
  • MBA or equivalent post-graduate qualification (preferred, not required).

  • Working knowledge of AI-powered analytics, predictive modeling, and modern business intelligence platforms.

  • Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex analytical concepts for senior business leaders.
  • Experience leading cross-functional analytical initiatives within highly matrixed organizations.

The Developer Platform organization is looking for a Software Engineering Manager to join our group in India. This organization develops and maintains the internal developer platform, security, compliance and audit reporting and all processes and controls that enable New Relic s fleet of engineers to effectively release our products to customers. jobDescription:
Project Role : Data Platform Architect

Project Role Description : Architects the data platform blueprint and implements the design, encompassing the relevant data platform components. Collaborates with the Integration Architects and Data Architects to ensure cohesive integration between systems and data models.

Must have skills : Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform

Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 12 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary:
Delivery and solution leadership role.
This role balances hands on architectural guidance with execution ownership, client leadership, and people development.

Responsibilities:

Proven experience as a Data Architect and Data Engineer leading enterprise-scale Lakehouse initiatives.
Expert-level understanding of modern Data Analytics Architecture patterns including Data Mesh, Data Products, and Lakehouse Architecture.
Excellent programming and debugging skills in Python.
Strong experience with PySpark for building scalable and modular ETL/ELT pipelines.
Design and build complex pipelines using Delta Lake, Auto Loader, Delta Live Tables (DLT), and deployment using Asset Bundles.
Architect data ingestion and transformation using DLT Expectations, modular Databricks Functions, and reusable pipeline components.
Must have hands-on expertise in at least one major cloud platform: AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Lead implementation of Unity Catalog: create catalogs, schemas, role-based access policies, lineage visibility, and data classification tagging (PII, PHI, etc.).
Guide organization-wide governance via Unity Catalog setup: workspace linkage, SSO, audit logging, external locations, and Volume access.
Enable cross-platform data access using Lakehouse Federation, querying live from externally hosted databases.
Leverage and integrate Databricks Marketplace to consume high-quality third-party data and publish internal data assets securely.
Experience with cloud-based services relevant to data engineering, data storage, data processing, data warehousing, real-time streaming, and serverless computing.
Govern and manage Delta Sharing for securely sharing datasets with external partners or across tenants.
Design and maintain PII anonymization, tokenization, and masking strategies using DBX functions and Unity Catalog policies to meet GDPR/HIPAA compliance.
Architect Power BI, Tableau, and Looker integration with Databricks for live reporting and visualization over governed datasets.
Build Databricks SQL Dashboards to enable stakeholders with real-time insights, KPI tracking, and alerts.
Hands on Experience in applying Performance optimization techniques
Lead cross-functional initiatives across data science, analytics, and platform teams to deliver secure, scalable, and value-aligned data products.
Provide thought leadership on adopting advanced features like Mosaic AI, Vector Search, Model Serving, and Databricks Marketplace publishing.
Working knowledge of DBT (Data Build Tool) is a plus.
Strong background in data modeling and data warehousing concepts is required.

Good to Have:
1. Certifications: Databricks Certified Professional or similar certifications.
2. Machine Learning: Knowledge of machine learning concepts and experience with popular ML libraries.
3. Knowledge of big data processing (e.g., Spark, Hadoop, Hive, Kafka)
4. Data Orchestration: Apache Airflow.
5. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices in a cloud environment.
6. Experience with ETL tools like Informatica, Talend, Matillion, or Fivetran.
7. Familiarity with DBT (Data Build Tool)

Education Qualification:
  • 15 years full time education is required.

    Qualification 15 years full time education
