jobDescription:
Project Role :Custom Software Engineer




Project Role Description :Develop custom software solutions to design, code, and enhance components across systems or applications. Use modern frameworks and agile practices to deliver scalable, high-performing solutions tailored to specific business needs.


Must have skills :SAP ABAP Cloud



Good to have skills :NA
Minimum

15 year(s) of experience is required



Educational Qualification :15 years full time education



Summary
Build AI native, cloud ready SAP solutions on ABAP Cloud by combining deep ABAP and SAP platform expertise with agentic AI architectures, LLM tooling, and rapid experimentation. The role focuses on designing, implementing, and scaling intelligent SAP applications that integrate ABAP Cloud with LLMs, retrieval pipelines, APIs, and enterprise systemsmoving from automation to autonomy.
This role actively builds AI systems, not just consumes AI tools.

Core Responsibilities
AI Native SAP Application Build
Design and build ABAP Cloud applications that embed LLM driven intelligence into SAP business processes.
Implement AI enabled SAP extensions using RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), event driven patterns, and cloud native architectures.
Develop clean, testable ABAP code that integrates seamlessly with AI services and enterprise APIs.
Agentic LLM Integration
Implement agentic workflows:tools, planners, memory, orchestration, and evaluation loops integrated with SAP processes.
Integrate LLMs, embeddings, and retrieval pipelines (RAG) with ABAP Cloud services for contextual, grounded responses.
Design prompt templates, grounding strategies, fallback logic, and safety boundaries suitable for enterprise SAP use cases.
Data, Retrieval Context
Build and integrate retrieval pipelines using SAP and non SAP data sources (business objects, CDS views, documents, events).
Implement chunking, indexing, embeddings, and context assembly to support production grade RAG scenarios.
Ensure factuality, traceability, and explainability in AI driven SAP workflows.
Quality, Safety Reliability
Implement evaluation frameworks (offline and online) for AI behaviors integrated with SAP processes.
Design guardrails for authorization, data privacy, action boundaries, and error handling.
Build observability into AI enabled SAP applications (telemetry, logging, failure analysis).
Rapid Experimentation Scale Out
Prototype quickly, demo frequently, and iterate based on business feedback.
Move AI prototypes into enterprise grade SAP production systems with performance, security, and compliance in mind.
Continuously refine AI behavior, prompts, and orchestration strategies.

Primary Skills (AI Native Must Have)
SAP ABAP Cloud (RAP, CDS, OData, clean core principles).
Hands on experience integrating LLMs and AI services into applications.
Experience building RAG pipelines, embeddings, and contextual retrieval.
Strong software engineering fundamentals (design, testing, CI/CD).
Ability to translate business problems into AI enabled SAP solutions.

Secondary / Strongly Beneficial Skills
Experience with SAP BTP, eventing, APIs, and cloud services.
Familiarity with agent frameworks or custom orchestration logic.
Exposure to vector databases, search, or semantic indexing (SAP native or external).
Knowledge of enterprise security, authorization, and compliance patterns.


Value Delivered
Intelligent SAP applications that reason, retrieve, and act, not just automate.
Faster innovation cycles by embedding AI directly into SAP business logic.
Scalable, secure AI powered SAP extensions aligned with clean core principles.
Foundation for autonomous, AI driven enterprise workflows.


Additional Information
A 15 years full time education is required.

Qualification
15 years full time education

You will empower developersfrom startups to Fortune 500 companiesto integrate advanced data and AI capabilities into their applications and solutions. If you are passionate about equipping builders and cultivating a vibrant developer ecosystem, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of development on MongoDB.
Our Builder Relations teams are distributed across the globe, with most members working remotely. To see what our team is doing, check out our content on
,
, and
.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

We are excited to welcome a technical leader to our team who, as a player coach, will drive engagement with customers and the community in India and across the region. At the foundation of your expertise is a love to equip others through hands-on workshops, architectural reviews, and building relationships directly with customers, and at events and user groups. To be successful, you will have at least 10 years of experience as a database expert, and 5 years of experience as a people manager. Ideally, you will have additional experience in a customer-facing role (such as solution architect), teaching, or related technical role, where youve led or advised teams as they solve their enterprise''s most critical data challenges, and have distributed code and content to support others.
You are known for your deep database expertise (familiarity with other data technologies and the ability to quickly become proficient in MongoDB), your insight into developer enablement programs, and your ability to guide development teams in the adoption of new technologies. Youre an excellent public speaker and are comfortable sitting across the table from architects or delivering live enablement sessions to technical audiences of 40 to 400. You are already building with AI for productivity and exploring AI-native solutions.
It is essential that you have a genuine passion for equipping other builders to be more productive and successful. Finally, you excel at explaining complex technical concepts in simple terms and have a natural ability to connect and communicate with developers of various skill levels. Your focus is not just on individual success but on the success of the entire team, consistent with MongoDB''s value of Building Together.
Position Expectations
  • Lead a highly technical team supporting regional customer and community engagement
  • Grow as a recognized subject matter expert on document schema design, building on a deep understanding of core and AI MongoDB capabilities
  • Deliver schema design review sessions to customer development teams to guide their design, architecture, and use of MongoDB in the context of their specific or potential workloads
  • Deliver live developer enablement sessions to audiences of 40 to 400 developers
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and other teams to develop and scale effective enablement content for builders within strategic accounts
  • Share and adapt our best practices for effective customer and community engagement in the region, track business impact, and report on feedback and insights your team is actively collecting
  • Mentor other team members including the surrounding ecosystem of Solutions Architects and Marketing partners.
Requirements
  • You have 10+ years of experience working with development or engineering teams in designing database schemas and implementing highly performant and scalable database methods, including 5 years of experience (or the equivalent) consulting with development teams as a non-member of the team
  • You have at least 5 years of experience managing and hiring technical teams of engineers or advocates
  • Strong presentation skills, with the ability to lead technical sessions at public events and online
  • Portfolio of code and content you''ve created, or led creation of, to enable developers and drive awareness
  • Willingness to travel (up to 60%)
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. title: Python Architect - AI
jobDescription:
Role summary

As Senior Python Architect, you will own the technical strategy and hands-on design for re-platforming the HIVE backend from PL/SQL to Python. You will reverse-engineer the current codebase, document the embedded business logic and data flows, define a target Python architecture (FastAPI, asynchronous processing, clean data-access patterns), establish a pragmatic and low-risk migration strategy with parity validation, and guide the engineering team through delivery. You will be hands-on producing reference implementations and resolving the hardest technical problems while also setting standards, mentoring engineers, and aligning with SFI's enterprise architecture governance (ARB).

Key responsibilities

Current-state assessment & discovery

  • Review the existing HIVE system end-to-end PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, triggers, cursors, scheduled jobs, and the React front-end touchpoints.
  • Reverse-engineer and document the embedded business logic, data models, integrations, batch/long-running processes, and dependencies that must be preserved.
  • Identify complexity hotspots, technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and risk areas; quantify the conversion effort and produce a phased, prioritized conversion blueprint.

Target architecture & design

  • Define the target-state Python architecture: service decomposition, FastAPI API design, asynchronous execution model (async/await, ASGI), data-access layer, configuration, and deployment topology.
  • Design patterns for asynchronous and long-running jobs (background workers, task queues, concurrency, idempotency, retries) to replace PL/SQL batch and scheduled processing.
  • Establish coding standards, project structure, reusable frameworks/accelerators, and Definition of Done; author Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
  • Define non-functional requirements — performance, scalability, security, observability, and maintainability — and design to meet them.

PL/SQL Python conversion strategy

  • Define a low-risk migration approach (e.g., incremental / strangler-fig) with clear sequencing, rollback paths, and coexistence with the current system during transition.
  • Establish a rigorous parity and data-reconciliation strategy so converted Python logic produces results equivalent to the original PL/SQL (record counts, field-level validation, transformation-rule verification).
  • Decide where logic should move from the database tier into the application tier, and define the data-access strategy against the existing Oracle backend.

Hands-on engineering & leadership

  • Build reference implementations / proofs-of-concept for the highest-risk conversion patterns; set the template the team follows.
  • Provide technical leadership, code review, and mentoring to Python and data engineers within the HIVE Fusion Team.
  • Drive engineering quality: automated testing (pytest), CI/CD, code quality gates, and regression coverage for converted modules.

Collaboration & governance

  • Partner with SFI HIVE / Digital Labs stakeholders to validate business logic and acceptance criteria.
  • Align designs with SFI's Architecture Review Board (ARB) and enterprise standards for security, integration, and platforms.
  • Where applicable, leverage Ascendion's AAVA platform and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate code understanding, conversion, and test generation.

Required skills & experience (must-have)

  • Python expert (3.10+): idiomatic, production-grade Python with strong design and OOP/functional fundamentals.
  • FastAPI: deep, hands-on experience designing and building REST APIs with FastAPI (Pydantic, dependency injection, ASGI servers such as Uvicorn/Gunicorn).
  • Asynchronous programming: strong command of asyncio, async/await, concurrency, and async I/O; designing asynchronous and long-running job execution.
  • PL/SQL & SQL (deep): expert ability to read, reverse-engineer, and translate large PL/SQL codebases — packages, procedures, functions, triggers, cursors — and tune SQL for performance.
  • Oracle database: solid working knowledge of Oracle (the current HIVE backend), data modeling, and query optimization.
  • AWS: hands-on experience designing, deploying, and running Python services on AWS — e.g., Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, RDS, S3, and IAM — including cost-aware, secure, and scalable cloud-native patterns.
  • Full-stack awareness: comfortable across the stack, including integration with a React front end and clean API contracts.
  • Application modernization / migration: proven track record converting or re-platforming legacy systems to modern Python services, with parity validation and zero-regression discipline.
  • Architecture: demonstrated experience as a solution/application architect — target-state design, NFRs, ADRs, and setting engineering standards.
  • Engineering practices: Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing (pytest), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes).
  • Experience: typically 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years in a senior architect capacity on data-intensive, business-critical systems.

Preferred / nice-to-have

  • Data access / ORM frameworks (e.g., SQLAlchemy), task queues / background workers (e.g., Celery, arq, RQ), and message/event-driven patterns.
  • Cloud & data platforms: Azure, GCP (incl. Gemini Enterprise); Databricks; Power BI / semantic layers.
  • AI / agentic engineering, GenAI-assisted code conversion, and exposure to AI acceleration platforms (e.g., AAVA).
  • Warehouse-management / supply-chain or food & CPG / manufacturing domain exposure.
  • Observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and API security best practices (authN/authZ, secrets management).

Role Overview 

We are seeking a hands-on Offensive Security leader to build and run adversarial testing across both our traditional attack surface and our AI systems. You will operate as a senior offensive practitioner and a team lead: personally, driving high-complexity red team engagements while directing a small team, setting methodology, and translating findings into concrete risk reduction for the business. 

This is a rare hybrid role. You must be a seasoned red teamer who can compromise networks, applications, cloud, and people — and equally comfortable in adversarial machine learning: attacking, evaluating, and hardening large language models (LLMs), and using frontier models as force multipliers for offensive work. 


Offensive Security & Red Teaming 

  • Plan and lead full-scope red team operations against networks, web/mobile applications, cloud environments, APIs, and identity systems, emulating real-world adversary TTPs and aligning to OWASP, OSSTMM, and MITRE ATT&CK. 

  • Execute end-to-end attack chains — initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and exfiltration — with modern C2 frameworks, developing custom tooling and payloads, and safely exercising detection and response capabilities alongside the blue team (purple teaming). 

  • Perform application security (AppSec) reviews, secure code review, penetration testing, and analysis and triage of bug bounty submissions to validate and prioritize real-world risk. 

  • Conduct social engineering, phishing, and physical/assumed-breach scenarios where scoped and authorized. 

  • Produce clear, prioritized findings with reproducible proof-of-concept, threat models, deep-dive reports, and pragmatic remediation plans for technical and executive audiences. 

AI / LLM Red Teaming 

  • Design and run adversarial testing of LLM-powered products and agents for prompt injection (direct and indirect), jailbreaks, sensitive data exposure, insecure tool/function-calling and plugin usage, training-data extraction, and unsafe autonomous behavior. 

  • Attack AI systems across multiple integration and attack surfaces — API, token-based, cURL, and headless-browser methods — and red-team MCP (Model Context Protocol) architectures, AI gateways, and native and third-party guardrails. 

  • Develop novel attack techniques against models and the surrounding application stack (RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, guardrails, model gateways), referencing frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI RMF. 

  • Build evaluation harnesses and automated red-teaming pipelines to measure model robustness, jailbreak resistance, and guardrail efficacy at scale. 

  • Partner with ML and product teams on mitigations — system-prompt hardening, input/output filtering, guardrail tuning, and safety fine-tuning — and re-test to prove effectiveness. 

    Required Qualifications 

    • Experience: 10+ years in offensive security / red teaming, with a track record of leading complex, full-scope engagements. 

    • Offensive depth: deep, demonstrable expertise across network, web/app, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and identity attacks, plus custom exploit and tooling development (Python, Go, or C/C++). 

    • AI security: hands-on experience attacking or securing LLM-based systems (prompt injection, jailbreaks, agent/tool abuse), Agentic AI architectures, MCP and AI-gateway security, and adversarial ML techniques, with a solid grasp of ML fundamentals. 

    • Model fluency: practical experience training, fine-tuning, or heavily operationalizing LLMs, and using frontier models to automate real work. 

    • Offensive AI use: proven, hands-on experience using LLMs to create offensive testing — building attack payloads, exploits, phishing content, red-team tooling, and automated test cases with model assistance. 

    • Leadership: able to communicate risk clearly to engineers and executives, and to lead and mentor others.

We are looking for a seasoned Software Engineer with hands-on Agentic and Generative AI experience to provide technical leadership on client engagements.   • Design RAG pipelines and agentic workflows tailored to client knowledge and data landscapes
  • Lead LLM integration strategy - model selection, prompt engineering, context management, and structured outputs across providers
  • Use AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, or equivalent) as a primary development tool; direct and validate AI-generated output with precision

  • Provide technical leadership on engagements - own solution design, drive requirements gathering and analysis, and guide the team through delivery
  • Lead client discovery sessions, technical scoping, and solution presentations; translate ambiguous business problems into well-defined AI solutions
  • Conduct design reviews, enforce engineering standards, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers
  • Drive technology selection; establish reusable patterns and internal frameworks that improve delivery across the team

Data, Analytics & Engineering

  • Contribute to data quality assessment, pipeline design, and insight delivery using Python, numpy, and pandas
  • Write clean, testable code following SOLID principles and design patterns; apply test-driven development practices and write unit tests as a standard part of delivery

  • Transformer architecture depth - model behavior, failure modes, tokenization, and fine-tuning tradeoffs

At Gigamon, our purpose is to protect the hybrid networks and data of the largest, most complex organizations on the planet. This helps our customers to eliminate security blind spots, optimize network traffic, and dramatically reduce tool cost and complexity, enabling them to better secure and manage their hybrid cloud infrastructure. Gigamon has served more than 4,000 customers worldwide, including over 80 percent of Fortune 100 enterprises, 9 of the 10 largest mobile network providers, and hundreds of governments and educational organizations.

As a Principal DevOps Engineer on our Engineering Services team, you will design, deliver, and operate the CI/CD and automation infrastructure that underpins Gigamon's embedded software products. You will lead the evolution of our continuous integration framework, partnering closely with cross-functional engineering teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable, robust solutions. In this senior role, you will act as a key technical authority for critical engineering tools and workflows, ensuring reliability, performance, and adherence to best practices. You will work autonomously to drive improvements in productivity, quality, and release velocity across multiple, overlapping product lines.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain CI pipelines using Jenkins, Gerrit, and GitLab for build and test automation of embedded software products.
  • Champion best practices for CI/CD, SDLC workflows, and quality gates across engineering teams.
  • Explore, evaluate, and implement new toolsets and optimizations to improve developer productivity and quality control.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and subject-matter expert for key engineering tools, including Gerrit, GitLab, Coverity, JIRA, TestRail, Black Duck, and Artifactory.
  • Administer Linux systems and applications, including patching, upgrading, and modifying configurations to meet evolving business and security requirements.
  • Provide frontline support for CI-related issues, triaging and resolving problems with the CI environment and production build infrastructure.
  • Manage the release and distribution of build artifacts to customer download portals, following strict change control processes and security best practices.
  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for CI/CD pipelines, tools, and infrastructure, and actively share knowledge and best practices across the team.
  • Collaborate with U.S.-based operations, including occasional weekend work and adjusted work hours as needed to support global teams.
  • (Nice to have) Administer and scale Jenkins environments, including patching and performance tuning.
  • (Nice to have) Contribute to code signing workflows and PKI infrastructure to support secure delivery.
  • (Nice to have) Partner with QA and test teams to integrate test automation and execution into CI/CD pipelines.

What you've done

  • Earned a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (or related field) and have 13+ years of hands-on experience with CI/CD systems and applications, including Linux administration.
  • Built and maintained complex Jenkins pipelines, with deep expertise in scripted pipelines and pipeline-as-code concepts.
  • Gained 10+ years of scripting experience in languages such as Python, Perl, or Groovy, and applied this expertise to automation, tooling, and infrastructure.
  • Developed expert-level proficiency with Git/GitLab and source control best practices, including branching strategies, code review workflows, and change management policies.
  • Implemented and supported continuous integration and software frameworks for pre- and post-commit gates in multi-tier application environments.
  • Administered and integrated tools such as JIRA, Coverity, Artifactory, Black Duck, and TestRail within a CI/CD ecosystem.
  • Supported rapid, overlapping product release cycles, ensuring reliable, repeatable builds and releases in a high-velocity engineering environment.
  • Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document systems and processes clearly and collaborate effectively with diverse technical teams.

Who you are

  • A hands-on technical leader who can operate autonomously, take ownership of complex problems, and drive solutions that align with department and organizational goals.
  • Calm and effective under pressure, with a strong sense of accountability for production CI/CD environments and release quality.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a disciplined approach to change control, security, and documentation.
  • A proactive collaborator who builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and serves as a trusted advisor on CI/CD and tooling.
  • Curious and improvement-focused, continually seeking opportunities to enhance tools, workflows, and automation to better support engineers and customers.

Ready to be a Titan

Were looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join our Site Reliability & Infrastructure Engineering team. We run entirely on the cloud, and this team owns the reliability and health of the applications running on top of it - designing the signals that tell us when somethings wrong, and building the systems that keep ServiceTitan running better, faster, and cheaper as we scale.

We make a huge impact on thousands of companies in the U.S. and abroad by enabling them to be more efficient and effective at running their business. Our Site Reliability and Infrastructure Engineering team centralizes the concerns of measurement and guidance so every engineer can improve availability and efficiency in their own area of the ServiceTitan cloud. We have a cultural foundation built on diversity, inclusion, and innovation, and we want you and your ideas to thrive at ServiceTitan. Come join us.

What Youll Do

  • Participate in an on-call rotation, using runbooks and playbooks to diagnose and resolve production issues (e.g., adjusting Horizontal Pod Autoscaler rules in response to load).

  • Design, build, and maintain observability dashboards and alerting grounded in Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

  • Operate and improve our Kubernetes-based compute platform, which runs the large majority of our infrastructure.

  • Work across cloud networking and infrastructure (Azure/AWS) to support reliable, scalable systems.

  • Investigate and resolve production incidents, including root-cause analysis and follow-up remediation work.

  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, MCP-based agents). Build SRE skills to automate investigations, ship fixes across infrastructure and application repositories

  • Define non-functional requirements - scalability, availability, performance - for new systems as theyre designed.

  • Partner with product engineering teams to review architecture and infrastructure decisions before they ship.

  • Drive adoption of best practices in reliability and observability across engineering teams.

  • Build and maintain automation that reduces manual, repetitive operational work across the team.

  • Write and maintain runbooks and documentation so on-call knowledge is shared across the team, not siloed with one person.

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and help teams ship changes safely and quickly.

What Youll Bring

  • Kubernetes (must-have): strong, hands-on understanding of Kubernetes as a system.

  • SRE principles: practical experience with SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets - able to speak to how youve defined and monitored these on real systems, not just definitions.

  • Cloud engineering & networking: solid grounding in AWS, GCP or Azure, including networking fundamentals (subnetting, IP addressing).

  • Observability: deep experience with at least one modern observability stack (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Elasticsearch) and the ability to translate that understanding across tools.

  • CI/CD: strong understanding of a CI/CD system (GitHub Actions preferred, but TeamCity, Azure DevOps, or GitLab CI experience is acceptable).

  • Experience building web applications on .NET stack, Python (Flask, FastAPI) or Java (Spring) deployed at scale

  • Foundational experience supporting distributed systems and their common failure modes (retry storms, timeouts, cascading failures) at scale.

  • Experience handling livesite incidents, troubleshooting skills - comfortable diagnosing issues under pressure with proven ability to raise the bar and improve TTx SLA.

  • Experience with AI tools (building SRE skills, root cause analysis agents deployed in production systems etc.) is required

  • 10+ years of relevant hands-on experience.

Be Human With Us:

Being human isn t about checking every box on a list. It s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we re solving. We re in this together. Come be human, with us.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Description:

The Tech Innovation Manager is the technical and architectural leader responsible for identifying, shaping, and delivering the next generation of BI and AI capabilities for Global Business Intelligence. This role sits at the intersection of data architecture, machine learning engineering, and platform strategy. It combines deep technical expertise with innovation leadership to advance how Ecolab delivers insights to its internal stakeholders.

This person provides architectural direction, accelerates adoption of new technologies, leads teams that are building conversational agents and BI-integrated applications. The tech innovation manager is the leader of an enabling team.

This person defines patterns, elevates technical talent, and ensures BIs technical tooling evolves in alignment with enterprise data and technology strategies.

This is a technical leadership role that guides BI Architects, ML Engineers, and Developers while collaborating heavily with Data Strategy and Engineering, Enterprise Technology, and Global Business Intelligence to bring new capabilities to life.

Key Responsibilities:

Technical Enablement and Architecture Leadership

  • Define patterns for ML operationalization, semantic layer strategy, conversational AI integration, monitoring frameworks, and CI/CD modernization.
  • Create reusable accelerators, templates, and frameworks to speed development across Global BI.
  • Ensure solutions meet enterprise expectations for reliability, observability, and lifecycle management.

Platform And BI Integration

  • Oversee engineering work that embeds BI assets directly into CRM systems or line-of-business tools.
  • Guide cross-functional teams through architectural design, data integration patterns, and API/automation opportunities.
  • Serve as technical liaison between BI developers and platform teams (DIAS, cloud engineering, security).

Oversight of Technical Innovation Pipeline

  • Lead teams building conversational AI agents, advanced BICRM integrations, and new user experiences for consuming insights.
  • Develop MVPs and reference architectures that accelerate adoption of emerging tools and methods.
  • Evaluate new technologies for suitability, scalability, security, and alignment with business value.

Team Leadership People Development

  • Lead, coach, and mentor a team of principal insights engineers (BI Architects or ML Engineers) with direct reporting lines.
  • Provide dotted-line guidance to BI Developers, Data Scientists, or Data Engineers who are committed to working with our teams.
  • Build a team that prioritizes curiosity, business understanding, and accountability.
  • Coach BI Developers towards best practices through direct enabling work.
  • Mentor and uplift technical practitioners across Global BI, providing guidance on modern methods in ML engineering, architecture, and advanced BI patterns.
  • Encourage a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and technical excellence.
  • Promote adoption of governance, security, and development standards through practical enablement, not just documentation.

Required Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in Data or BI architecture, ML engineering, Data Engineering, or adjacent technical fields. Including 5+ years leading technical teams or architect communities.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and leading delivery of advanced BI, ML, or data platform capabilities.
  • Strong hands-on technical expertise in:
  • ML/AI operationalization or conversational agent development
  • Semantic layer design and complex data modeling
  • Cloud-based analytics platforms
  • Proven ability to set architectural direction and influence stakeholders across multiple technical teams.
  • Strong communication skills; able to translate complex concepts into actionable guidance for technical and business audiences.
  • Experience with governance, security, and lifecycle management of data/analytics systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with enterprise systems such as SAP, CRM, Dynamics (CRM)
  • Data Visualization Experience (PowerBI)
  • Experience with Snowflake, Snowpark/Cortex, or Databricks.
  • Prior leadership experience in a global or matrixed environment

descriptionFromApi:
About Darwinbox
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries. Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Airtel, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more. Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Delivery Assurance Manager to join our dynamic team and ensure that every Darwinbox Implementation delivers the desired transformational value to our enterprise users.

The Delivery Assurance Manager serves as a key liaison between implementation teams, clients, and internal stakeholders, ensuring that all deliverables meet defined quality standards, timelines are adhered to, and client expectations are exceeded throughout the implementation lifecycle alongside ensuring their readiness to manage the system in the long run.
Key Responsibilities


Project Delivery Management
Oversee end-to-end Delivery Assurance for multiple concurrent Darwinbox Enterprise implementations across modules and geographies
Ensure adherence to Darwinboxs Implementation methodology Inflexion and established best practices
Drive timebound corrective actions via Client and Implementation Team leadership to ensure that the required resources with desired capabilities are available for the project.
Serve as the strategic compass to ensure that Day 1 desired value is delivered on go-live based upon the E3 methodology (Experience, Effectiveness and Efficiency).


Quality Assurance and Risk Management
Identify potential risks, issues, and bottlenecks early and develop mitigation strategies
Ensure that regular delivery checkpoints and quality reviews are carried out and corrective actions completed in time throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Implement continuous improvement initiatives based on lessons learned and improvements loop closed with client, implementation teams and other internal stakeholders.
Steer Risk Management and Mitigation discussions during Steering Committee Meetings and leadership connections.


Client Relationship Management
Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, providing expert guidance at every stage of the project and enabling the client to Champion the Thriving in the Cloud approach.
Handle escalations and work collaboratively with clients to resolve complex issues
Drive client engagement initiatives and maintain strong relationships throughout the project duration
Oversee Implementation Team to User handovers post-implementation and ensure successful transition in conjunction with Darwinbox Customer Success Teams.


Process Optimisation and Innovation
Design and refine delivery processes, methodologies, and documentation; maintain and progressively improve delivery templates, checklists, and knowledge repositories
Analyze delivery metrics and provide insights for organizational improvement
Stay current with HR technology trends and integrate innovative approaches into delivery practices
Act as custodian of the Delivery Scorecard and corresponding actions for Implementations teams.
Lead special projects focused on integrating AI tools into Delivery Assurance Processes.
Qualifications
10 years of experience in HRMS/SaaS implementation (HR domain preferred), with 4+ years in Darwinbox/Workday/similar global HCM platforms deployments
Bachelors degree in Business, IT, or related. MBA degree preferred (MBA, MS in Technology Management or equivalent)
Certifications like Darwinbox, PMP, PRINCE2, Six Sigma or Agile/Scrum Master preferred
Deep understanding of HR Business Processes across multiple modules: Core HR, Talent Development and Management, Employee Engagement, Payroll, leave, attendance and others.
Skills & Competencies
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
Proficient in planning tools (JIRA, MS Projects or similar Project Management tools) and MS Office suite
Familiarity with data migration, APIs, Excel/SQL/spreadsheets
Strong project governance, risk mitigation, and multi-stakeholder coordination capabilities
Ability to prioritize, multitask, and drive projects under tight timeline

title: Consultant-Data Architect / Modern Data & AI Architecture
jobDescription:
Job Description Data Architect Consultant
Position: Data Architect Consultant | Modern Data & AI Architecture
Experience: 10+ years
Mode- Freelancer/ Consultant
Role Overview
We are looking for an experienced Data Architect Consultant to design scalable, secure and high-performance enterprise data architectures across cloud, data platforms, analytics and AI workloads.
The candidate will work with business, engineering, analytics and AI teams to define end-to-end data architecture, including data ingestion, integration, storage, processing, modeling, governance, security and consumption.
The role also requires the ability to design AI-ready data platforms supporting Generative AI, RAG, AI agents and advanced analytics.
Required Skills
Must Have
10+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Architecture.
Strong experience designing enterprise data architectures.
Strong SQL and data modeling expertise.
Experience with Data Warehouse / Data Lake / Lakehouse architectures.
Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform AWS, Azure or GCP.
Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or BigQuery.
Strong understanding of ETL/ELT, APIs, batch and streaming architectures.
Strong understanding of data governance, security, quality and lineage.
Experience working with senior business and technical stakeholders.
AI / GenAI Required
Understanding of AI-ready data architecture.
Practical exposure to GenAI / LLM / RAG architectures.
Understanding of vector databases and semantic/hybrid search.
Understanding of how enterprise data is consumed by AI applications and agents.
Good to Have
Data Mesh / Data Fabric experience.
Apache Kafka / event-driven architecture.
Apache Iceberg / Delta Lake.
Microsoft Fabric.
Databricks.
Snowflake.
Data Vault.
Knowledge Graphs / Graph databases.
Experience with MCP / Agentic AI architectures.
Experience with AI data governance.
Experience with ML/AI platforms and MLOps.
Terraform / Infrastructure as Code.
FinOps / cloud cost optimization.

Key Responsibilities
1. Data Architecture & Strategy
Define enterprise and solution-level data architecture strategies and roadmaps.
Design scalable architectures across Data Warehouse, Data Lake, Lakehouse, Data Fabric and Data Mesh patterns.
Evaluate build-vs-buy, technology and platform choices based on business, scalability, cost and performance requirements.
Define architecture standards, principles and reusable patterns.
2. Modern Data Platforms
Design cloud-native data platforms across AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
Architect modern lakehouse solutions using technologies such as:
oDatabricks
oSnowflake
oMicrosoft Fabric
oBigQuery
oDelta Lake / Apache Iceberg
Design batch, near-real-time and real-time data processing architectures.
3. Data Engineering & Integration
Define architecture for:
oETL/ELT
oAPI-based integration
oStreaming pipelines
oEvent-driven architectures
oData ingestion and transformation
Work with Data Engineers to establish scalable and reusable pipeline patterns.
Define integration strategies across enterprise applications and data sources.
4. Data Modeling
Design:
oConceptual, logical and physical data models
o3NF models
oDimensional models
oStar/Snowflake schemas
oData Vault where applicable
Define enterprise data models, master data and business semantics.
Establish standards for structured and unstructured data.
5. Data Governance & Security
Define enterprise data governance frameworks covering:
oData ownership
oData quality
oMetadata
oData lineage
oData classification
oRetention
oAccess control
Work with platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, Alation or equivalent.
Ensure compliance, privacy and security requirements are incorporated into architecture.
AI / GenAI Data Architecture
This should be a key differentiator for the modern Data Architect profile.
6. AI-Ready Data Architecture
Design data architectures that support Generative AI, RAG, AI copilots and Agentic AI.
Define how structured, unstructured and semi-structured enterprise data can be made available to AI systems.
Design data pipelines for AI ingestion, preprocessing, metadata and retrieval.
Define architecture for enterprise knowledge bases and AI-ready data products.

jobDescription:
Are you the kind of tech leader who looks at a manual process and thinks, Surely we can automate this?


We expect this role to run a modern, AI-native engineering practice rather than a traditional development team. In practice that means:


  • AI-assisted by default: modern coding tools and agents are part of everyday development, not an experiment. You decide where they are used and hold the team to a consistent standard of output.
  • Human accountability, always: AI accelerates the work, but a named human owns every design decision and every line that ships. Security-sensitive and customer-facing code is always human-reviewed.
  • Tool-agnostic: you pick the right tool for the job across the ecosystem GitHub Copilot and Copilot Workspace as a Microsoft-first default, alongside tools such as Cursor and Claude Code and re-evaluate as the field moves.
  • Multi-cloud: you are equally comfortable designing and deploying on both Azure and AWS, and choosing between them on merit.
  • Leverage over headcount: a smaller team that is deliberate about tooling, architecture and reuse, rather than scaling by adding people.

Location: Mohali/Chandigarh (Flexi- 1 WFH a week)



About us

Oreta is a multi-award-winning Australian technology and cybersecurity organisation, renowned for delivering transformative cloud and infrastructure solutions. Recognized by industry leaders such as ARN, CRN, and Telstra, Oreta has consistently demonstrated its commitment to innovation and excellence.


As a Microsoft Gold Partner in Cloud Platform, Oreta has showcased deep expertise in deploying advanced cloud solutions, particularly leveraging Microsoft Azure. This prestigious status reflects the company's rigorous technical proficiency and its dedication to helping clients modernize their infrastructure efficiently.


Further cementing its position in the industry, Oreta was honored with the Breakthrough Partner of the Year award at the Ingram Micro ONE Innovation Summit. This accolade recognized Oreta's holistic solutions, including security bundles based on Microsoft Sentinel, Copilot Assessments, and initiatives driving Azure growth through infrastructure migration and AI adoption.

With a proven track record of optimizing costs, streamlining operations, and enhancing network performance, Oreta stands out as a go-to partner for businesses aiming to embrace secure and modern digital ecosystems.


With a track record of delivering over 150 cloud projects and managing more than 1,400 network sites, Oreta continues to drive business transformation through agility, innovation, and enhanced user experiences .


Key Responsibilities

  • Own the technical delivery of Oretas software products end to end architecture, design, development, review, testing and release across a diverse, multi-cloud technology stack.
  • Lead a small, high-leverage engineering team, setting the standard for how work is planned, built, reviewed and shipped.
  • Define and own the teams approach to AI-assisted development: which tools are used (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), where they add value, and the guardrails that govern their use.
  • Review and verify AI-generated and human-written code to the same high standard, with particular rigour around security, licensing, third-party dependencies and long-term maintainability.
  • Design, build and document scalable, maintainable software components and services across the front end, back end and data layers.
  • Architect and build AI-native features into Oretas products moving beyond using AI to build, to embedding AI capability in what customers use.
  • Own technical change management, source control, CI/CD pipelines and technical documentation using modern best practice.
  • Design and evolve data models and database architecture; ensure data is stored, retrieved and secured efficiently across relational and non-relational stores.
  • Evaluate third-party components, frameworks, cloud services and AI tooling for inclusion in the product architecture.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship, growing the capability of the team including how they work effectively and safely with AI tooling.
  • Collaborate with product and business stakeholders to translate needs into technical direction, and communicate status, trade-offs and risk clearly.
  • Drive initiatives to modernise existing product architectures, and present findings and recommendations to senior management in a clear, actionable manner.
  • Ensure design and build documentation in Oretas systems is accurate and consistent, fostering clarity across operational processes.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven experience as a technical lead, software architect or senior full stack engineer, with genuine architect-level depth and a track record of shipping production software.
  • Strong software design fundamentals — design principles, architectural patterns and the judgement to know when to apply them. These matter more, not less, when reviewing AI-generated code at volume.
  • Hands-on full stack capability across a modern back end (e.g. C#/.NET, Python, Node.js) and front end (e.g. React/TypeScript or equivalent), with strong API design (REST/JSON, and familiarity with GraphQL).
  • Demonstrated, practical use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code), and the ability to set standards for their safe and effective use — including reviewing and verifying AI-generated code.
  • Multi-cloud engineering experience: designing, deploying and operating applications on both Azure and AWS, including their managed application, container and serverless services.
  • Strong database and data skills, including:
  • Relational database design and development — e.g. SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Azure SQL, Amazon RDS/Aurora — with advanced SQL.
  • Data modelling for both transactional (OLTP) and analytical/reporting (OLAP) workloads.
  • Query optimisation and performance tuning — indexing strategy, execution plans and troubleshooting slow queries.
  • Working knowledge of NoSQL / non-relational stores (e.g. Cosmos DB, DynamoDB) and sound judgement on when to use them.
  • Data migration, backup/restore and integrity across environments and clouds.
  • Solid grounding in modern delivery: Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and automated testing.
  • Security-conscious by default — fitting for Oreta’s cyber security heritage — across application code, dependencies, data and cloud configuration.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to break complex technical challenges into pragmatic, well-reasoned solutions.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to mentor engineers and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications are a plus — e.g. Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or TOGAF.

Perks and benefits


Oreta takes pride in providing a service of excellence to our customers and looking after our employees who enable our business to succeed. The successful applicant will enjoy working in a collaborative environment in Chandigarh, India with a friendly and highly driven people (the Oreos), where ideas are always welcome and ongoing training and development is strongly encouraged. The renumeration will be negotiated and based on the relevant skills and experience of the successful applicant. If you are interested in a long-term career with potential to develop and grow with the business and are available to start immediately, then we look forward to hearing from you.

descriptionFromApi:
Job Summary

Title - AVP - IT Vendor Manager

Level - 4B

About the Function:

Digital Technology (DT) is transforming how Diageo works, from how we source ingredients to how we connect with customers and consumers around the world.

This is where data, technology and creativity come together to solve real business challenges and unlock new opportunities. Whether it s building platforms, using data to drive decisions or shaping digital experiences, the work here has tangible impact across every part of our business.

You ll be part of a team that s constantly learning, experimenting and pushing boundaries, with the freedom to explore new ideas and the support to turn them into reality.

About the role

The IT Vendor Manager is responsible for re-establishing and leading a centralized Vendor Management Office (VMO) within GBS. The role ensures that Diageo s outsourcing strategy delivers its intended benefits by aligning vendors with business objectives, monitoring vendor performance, and ensuring consistent, high-quality service delivery.

This role is critical to:

  • Drive accountability and clarity in vendor relationships.
  • Enable value realization from outsourcing agreements.
  • Ensure consistent, standardized vendor management practices across the portfolio.
  • Support Diageo s strategic objectives by building trusted, goal-oriented partnerships with IT vendors.
  • Lead the maturity, and continual evolution of the Vendor Management Office (VMO)
  • Establish governance that drives operational excellence, commercial value, supplier accountability, and business outcomes across all strategic technology partners.
  • Drive standardization of vendor governance, performance management, and supplier engagement across the enterprise.

Responsibilities

Vendor Management Strategy Governance

  • Define, establish, and maintain Diageo s Vendor Management strategy, roadmap, and governance model.
  • Develop standardized processes, tools, and reporting mechanisms for vendor management.
  • Drive adoption of centralized vendor management practices across all Value Streams / verticals
  • Define and maintain the Vendor Management Operating Model, governance framework, policies, standards, and guidelines.
  • Establish governance forums including Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and Operational Review Boards.
  • Develop and monitor vendor performance scorecards aligned to strategic business outcomes.
  • Drive governance maturity across all strategic suppliers through continual improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure vendor governance aligns with Diageos Operational Excellence and Service Management strategy.

Performance Relationship Management

  • Oversee vendor performance management, including KPIs, SLAs, and continuous improvement.
  • Conduct regular vendor reviews, raising and resolving issues to maintain service quality.
  • Develop vendor scorecards and dashboards to provide a single, consistent view of vendor performance.
  • Build strategic partnerships with vendors to develop collaboration, innovation, and long-term value.
  • Define vendor performance objectives aligned with business priorities and transformation initiatives.
  • Sponsor strategic Service Improvement Plans (SIPs) and oversee delivery of agreed improvement commitments.
  • Champion supplier innovation by encouraging partners to introduce new capabilities, automation, AI, and service improvements.
  • Drive executive-level supplier relationships that develop collaboration, transparency, and long-term partnership.

Contract Financial Oversight

  • Support contract negotiations, renewals, and compliance management. Ensure commercial terms are monitored and implemented to improve value delivery and cost efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Procurement, Legal, and Finance to align vendor arrangements with Diageo s policies and financial objectives.
  • Provide strategic oversight of vendor commercial performance, ensuring delivery of contractual value and agreed business benefits. Support sourcing strategies, RFP evaluations, vendor selection, and contract award decisions.
  • Find opportunities for cost optimization, service rationalization, and vendor consolidation. Monitor vendor investment commitments and value-realization against case

Risk Management Compliance

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate vendor-related risks (operational, financial, regulatory, reputational).
  • Ensure adherence to regulatory, data protection, and security requirements. Monitor vendor procedures for concluding partnerships and ensuring business continuity.
  • Provide executive oversight of supplier risks and ensure appropriate mitigation strategies are implemented.
  • Ensure suppliers maintain robust Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Cyber Security, and Regulatory compliance capabilities.

Vendor Lifecycle Management

  • Define and govern the end-to-end vendor lifecycle from onboarding through ongoing management, renewal, transition, and exit.
  • Ensure appropriate governance is maintained during vendor transitions and organizational change.
  • Drive structured onboarding and offboarding processes for strategic suppliers.

Operational Excellence

  • Drive continual improvement of vendor management processes, governance, reporting, and operating models. Define maturity roadmaps and benchmark supplier performance against industry standard methodology. Promote standardization and simplification across vendor management practices.

Leadership People

  • Lead, coach, and develop the Vendor Management Office team. Build organizational capability across Vendor Management, Supplier Governance, and Commercial Management subject areas. Promote a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continual improvement.

Stakeholder Engagement Influence

  • Act as the central point of contact for all vendor management activities. Collaborate with Value Stream leaders to ensure vendor alignment with business priorities. Provide senior leadership with clear insights and recommendations on vendor performance and strategy.

Experience / Skills Required

  • 12+ years experience in IT Service Management, Service Delivery, or Operational Governance roles.
  • Strong understanding of IT outsourcing models, service delivery frameworks, and vendor lifecycle management.
  • Proven experience managing AMS or Infrastructure vendors in complex, multi-region organizations.

LIN SCAN provides comprehensive in-line inspection solutions for the oil and gas industry, ensuring pipeline integrity through highly accurate data for maintenance and repair programs.     • Ensure tool/Manpower rent is paid on time.

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.


As a Staff Engineer Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence, you will define and lead the technical direction of Safe s network reachability and attack-path intelligence capabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

You will be the hands-on architect behind systems that connect network topology, identities, vulnerabilities, security controls, and business-critical assets to determine how attackers can move through an enterprise environment.

You ll collaborate with product, backend, graph, data, AI, and platform teams to build scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready attack-path capabilities.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role. You will architect systems, build prototypes, write production-quality code, and help shape how Safe s CTEM platform identifies and breaks the attack paths that pose the greatest business risk.

Core Responsibilities:
  • Architect Safe s Attack Path Intelligence: Define the architecture and data model for network topology, effective reachability, trust boundaries, identities, vulnerabilities, controls, and attack paths across complex enterprise environments.
  • Build Core Attack Path Capabilities: Write production-quality code for network configuration parsing, reachability analysis, attack-graph construction, graph traversal, exposure chaining, and blast-radius computation. Build prototypes and evolve them into reliable, enterprise-scale services.
  • Model Effective Network Reachability: Derive actual connectivity from routing tables, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and segmentation policies rather than relying only on documented topology.
  • Model Attacker Movement: Build reasoning systems that connect exposed services, vulnerabilities, credentials, Active Directory privileges, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and access to critical assets.
  • Prioritize Actionable Attack Paths: Distinguish theoretical paths from reachable, exploitable, and business-critical attack paths. Incorporate exploitability, control effectiveness, asset criticality, and business impact into prioritization.
  • Enterprise Security Integrations: Design integrations with firewalls, routers, NAC, EDR, CMDB, Active Directory, vulnerability scanners, NetFlow, cloud platforms, and other enterprise security systems.
  • Countermeasure Intelligence: Build a vendor-neutral model for recommending segmentation, isolation, firewall-policy changes, access-control improvements, and compensating controls. Define validation, approval, safety, and rollback requirements.
  • AI and Graph Integration: Partner with other engineers to ensure attack-path explanations and countermeasure recommendations are evidence-backed, explainable, technically accurate, and governed through deterministic safety policies.
  • Validation & Governance: Build reference attack scenarios, simulation environments, regression datasets, and validation frameworks to verify attack paths and proposed countermeasures without introducing unacceptable operational risk.
  • Mentor & Multiply: Guide backend, graph, security, and platform engineers through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, engineering standards, and complex security-domain decisions.
Minimum Qualifications:

Experience: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, network security, security product engineering, exposure management, or related areas, with a strong record of building and shipping production systems.

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, Go, Java, or a similar backend language
  • Recent experience writing and shipping production-quality software not only providing architectural or advisory guidance
  • Strong system-design, API-design, data-modeling, and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Experience implementing graph traversal, rule-processing, network automation, configuration analysis, or security analytics
  • Ability to independently prototype complex ideas and evolve them into scalable production capabilities
  • Familiarity with graph databases and graph-processing technologies

Network Security

  • Deep understanding of enterprise on-premises, cloud, and hybrid networks
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and network segmentation
  • Experience deriving effective reachability across complex network configurations
  • Understanding of firewall-policy analysis, change validation, control effectiveness, and security misconfiguration detection

Attack Path & Identity Security

  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Kerberos, identity privilege paths, credential exposure, privilege escalation, and lateral movement
  • Experience with attack graphs, attack-path analysis, threat modelling, breach simulation, or exposure chaining
  • Ability to connect vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with network reachability and attacker behaviour
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common enterprise attack techniques

Product Engineering: Experience translating deep security-domain knowledge into scalable products, analytical systems, or security-platform capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building attack-path, network digital-twin, microsegmentation, or CTEM products
  • Experience with graph databases and large-scale graph computation
  • Experience with BloodHound, Nmap, Zeek, Wireshark, NetFlow, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Forward Networks, XM Cyber, RedSeal, AlgoSec, Tufin, FireMon, or comparable platforms
  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, Juniper, or other enterprise network-control technologies
  • Exposure to Pentera, AttackIQ, Picus, Horizon3.ai, or other security-validation platforms
  • Background spanning both offensive and defensive security
  • Experience safely validating security controls in production-like environments
  • Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP networking
  • Experience working with large, complex, and highly regulated enterprises
  • Certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CISSP, CCIE Security, CCNP Security, or GIAC
  • Published research, patents, open-source contributions, or previous technical leadership in security-product engineering is a strong plus

jobDescription:
Inviting applications for the role of Agentic Workspace Solution Director in the United States or India.

The Agentic Workspace Solution Director is the strategic leader and senior subject matter expert for Genpact's Agentic Workspace solution. You will support the vision, intellectual property, and go-to-market for how we help enterprise clients reimagine the modern workplace through agentic AI building, configuring, and demonstrating solutions on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, and Microsoft Foundry, while remaining fluent across the broader agentic ecosystem (Adobe, Opal (Gemini), Anthropic, and beyond).

You will lead Genpact's proprietary IP in this space, Agentic Experience suite, and our Digital Workspace IP Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. You will partner with sales to run demos and hands-on configuration sessions, shape multi-platform proposals, and guide our internal teams in solutioning. Success in this role is measured by growth in Agentic Workspace pipeline and wins, the maturity and adoption of our IP, and the enablement of teams to deliver client outcomes that increase employee productivity and unlock new ways of working.

Responsibilities

Solution Development & Sales Enablement

  • Agentic Workspace Solution Strategy: Collaborate with clients and Genpact sales teams to understand business goals, employee experience pain points, and the operating model the client wants to move toward. Define tailored Agentic Workspace solutions combining Microsoft technologies and translate technical capabilities into executive-friendly value stories with clear linkage to productivity gains, cost takeout, and revenue enablement.
  • (Required) Microsoft Platform Mastery: Serve as Genpact's senior solution SME for the Microsoft agentic stack. Maintain deep, current expertise in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. Maintain a deep understanding of Microsoft's agentic roadmap (new releases, private previews, partner programs) and translate that into opportunities for our clients.
  • (Bonus) Multi-Vendor Agentic Fluency: Bring credible, hands-on experience across the broader agentic ecosystem including Adobe, OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. Advise clients on when to lead with Microsoft, when to compose across vendors, and how to make pragmatic build/buy/compose decisions. Use this fluency to design heterogeneous agent architectures and to position Genpact as a platform-agnostic transformation partner.
  • Sales Demos & Live Configuration: Act as the lead solution architect in the sales cycle for Agentic Workspace opportunities. Run high-impact, customer-facing demos and live configuration sessions. Showcase Agentic Experience suite, Spark Workspace and Spark Connect scenarios in front of client audiences. Drive discovery workshops, craft compelling proposals and RFP responses, scope effort, and coordinate with engineering to validate feasibility (scope, timeline, budget). Your goal is to increase win rate by delivering proposals that are both visionary and credible.

IP Ownership, Go-to-Market & Thought Leadership

  • Agentic Experience Suite IP Leader: Own the roadmap, productization, and evolution of Genpact's Agentic Experience suite. Define the offers, reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets that make up the suite. Prioritize investment based on client demand and competitive differentiation; and ensure each component has clear value propositions, pricing, and delivery playbooks. Partner with Delivery and Engineering to harden field-built solutions into reusable IP and retire or refactor assets as the agentic landscape evolves.
  • Digital Workspace IP Leader (Spark Workspace & Spark Connect): Serve as the senior product owner for Rightpoint's Digital Workspace IP, including Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. Set the vision and feature roadmap, drive design and engineering priorities, oversee productization and packaging, and ensure tight alignment with the Microsoft platform stack and the broader Agentic Experience suite.
  • Thought Leadership: Be a recognized thought leader internally and externally for Agentic Workspace. Author whitepapers, blog posts, and whitepapers; speak at industry events, Microsoft partner forums, and client roundtables; and contribute to Genpact's brand as a leading agentic systems integrator.
  • Change Management for Agentic Adoption: Recognize that introducing agents into the workplace is a change management challenge as much as a technology one. Advise clients on agent governance, role design, training, and adoption and bake these into the solution so that Agentic Transformation is sustainable, responsible, and measurable.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Solution win rate in deals supported (e.g., percentage of proposals with this architect’s designs that convert to project wins), indicating ability to craft compelling, value-aligned architectures.
  • Quality of architecture in delivery: measured by post-implementation results such as performance benchmarks, scalability (can the platform handle expected load), and low incidence of architecture-related issues or rework during build.
  • Client satisfaction and business outcomes attributable to architecture: e.g., a client’s improved site performance or quicker content deployment times due to the designed solution (mapping back to KPIs the architect aimed to achieve).
  • Reusability of designs / accelerators: number of times architecture templates or components (developed under the architect’s guidance) are reused across projects, indicating creation of scalable best practices.
  • Continuous learning: staying certified/up-to-date – for example, maintaining relevant certs and attending partner training; success can be partially measured by completing new certifications or contributing to thought leadership (blogs, tech talks) on multi-platform solutions.

Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years in technical architecture roles for digital workspace and employee experience platforms, including substantial hands-on experience with Microsoft products (M365, Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint) in complex enterprise implementations.
  • Microsoft Agentic Platform Mastery: Deep expertise across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, and Azure AI Foundry, with working knowledge of Power Platform, SAM, Entra, and Purview as they relate to agent governance. Hands-on experience building and configuring agents is required.
  • Customer-Facing Sales & Solution Strength: 10+ years in solution consulting, pre-sales, or digital strategy, including a strong track record of leading executive sales demos and hands-on configuration sessions for enterprise audiences. Proven ability to shape and win large, multi-million-dollar digital transformation programs from discovery through proposal and SOW.
  • IP Ownership Experience: Demonstrated experience owning and evolving productized IP including roadmap definition, packaging, GTM enablement, and field adoption. You understand the difference between a one-off solution and a repeatable asset, and you can build the latter.
  • Digital Workspace Domain Depth: Strong understanding of the modern digital workplace; intranets, employee portals, knowledge management, frontline tooling, and the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack.
  • AI and Digital Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated enthusiasm for and fluency in agentic AI, automation, and emerging tech. You can envision "what's next" for clients and incorporate that into solution plans, positioning Genpact as an innovator.
  • Collaboration & Leadership: Team-oriented leader who thrives in a matrixed consulting environment. Able to lead cross-functional solution teams without formal authority (strategists, UX, engineers, and partner alliance colleagues) toward a unified proposal. Agency or consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Self-Starter with Organizational Savvy: Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You manage your own time and priorities across multiple pursuits, develop new ideas with minimal guidance, and exercise sound judgment on when to involve others.

Preferred Certifications & Expertise

  • Microsoft: Microsoft Certified — Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert. Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement badges strongly preferred.
  • Other relevant credentials: TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification; AWS or GCP architect certifications welcome alongside Azure.
  • Change & Adoption: Prosci or similar Change Management certification is a plus, reflecting ability to guide organizational adoption of agentic AI.

Why Genpact?

  • Be a transformation leader and work at the cutting edge of AI, automation, and digital innovation
  • Make an impact by driving change for global enterprises and solving business challenges that matter
  • Thrive in a values-driven culture
  • Flexible PTO — If you need a day off or an extended vacation, take the time!
  • Hybrid work environment: Casual and open office or RemoteYou choose!
  • Great insurance coverage (Multiple Options) and flexible spending accounts
  • 401K with Company Matching
  • Continuous Training, Certifications, and Learning Opportunities
  • Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion: We care about making Genpcat a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization to bring about meaningful and measurable changes to representation, team member experience, and client engagement. Our Employee Resource Groups (ERG) are created and run by team members who share a common community, identity, or allyship. These groups play a vital role in contributing to Genpact's inclusive environment where all are valued and empowered to succeed.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

descriptionFromApi:
The Role

We are currently seeking a Staff Software Engineer, Infrastructure to join the AI Platform team that powers seamless insights and interaction through natural language and data intelligence across our AI products.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll architect, build, and operate the backend and platform systems that power AI Platform. You’ll work across service design, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, event-driven processing, observability, CI/CD, and production reliability, helping shape the technical direction of a platform that supports scalable, client-facing AI experiences.

This role requires a strong software engineering foundation combined with deep infrastructure and systems thinking. We are looking for an engineer who can write high-quality production code, make sound architectural tradeoffs, and own platform capabilities end-to-end — not someone focused only on scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling in isolation.

You will collaborate closely with frontend, product, and AI/ML engineers to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable systems that align with Addepar’s standards of performance, resilience, and trust.

Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, build, and operate backend services and infrastructure that power AI Platform products.
  • Write high-quality production code for platform and service layers, with strong emphasis on maintainability, reliability, and performance.
  • Architect and evolve distributed systems that support AI Platform capabilities such as real-time interactions, asynchronous processing, and secure data workflows.
  • Build and extend cloud-native infrastructure across core services, networking, storage, identity, and observability layers.
  • Design and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, including reusable modules, environment management, and drift-safe workflows.
  • Build and operate Kubernetes/EKS-based services, including deployment strategies, health checks, scaling configuration, and containerization workflows.
  • Design and improve CI/CD pipelines, release workflows, and engineering productivity systems.
  • Build and maintain asynchronous and event-driven systems using queues, RPC/service communication, and resilient failure-handling patterns.
  • Design and evolve relational and NoSQL data models, including schema design, migrations, replication, and access patterns.
  • Build and maintain observability across metrics, logs, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.
  • Apply secure-by-default engineering practices across IAM, secrets, encryption, network isolation, and production operations.
  • Mentor engineers through code review, design review, incident reviews, and technical guidance.
  • Drive technical decisions that improve platform reliability, scalability, developer productivity, and long-term system health.
Who You Are
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • At least 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience in backend, infrastructure OR platform oriented work.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one production backend language such as Python (preferred), Go, OR Java and the ability to work effectively across a polyglot environment.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, debugging, code quality, testing, and operational ownership.
  • Deep hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure in production environments.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code workflows such as Terraform or equivalent tools.
  • Experience with Kubernetes/EKS, Docker, and modern deployment practices.
  • Experience designing or extending CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
  • Experience with distributed systems, microservice communication, message queues, asynchronous processing, and failure handling.
  • Experience with both relational and NoSQL database design in production systems.
  • Strong observability and production-debugging skills.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills.
  • Ability to operate as a software engineer first: we are not looking for someone who is only strong in scripting, cloud configuration, or infrastructure tooling without corresponding depth in production software engineering.
Bonus
  • Experience with AI/ML platform tooling such as Databricks, Spark, MLflow, or model-serving systems.
  • Experience with real-time streaming or WebSocket-based systems at scale.
  • Experience with multi-region architectures, data residency, or failover design.
  • Experience in fintech or other highly regulated environments.
  • Experience optimizing platform cost, performance, and reliability tradeoffs at scale.

Important Note: This role requires working from our Pune office 3 days a week (Hybrid work model)
